text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having won two GⅠ races at Tokyo 
Racecourse, Eishin Flash gives a wry smile 
when her Trainer remarks that Tokyo must 
be her strong suit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She recounted the memory of getting lost 
in the vast station the first day she came 
to Tokyo.
